page: The UpCloud PREMIUM-2xCPU-2GB is a compute-focused virtual machine instance built on KVM hypervisor technology. Powered by the AMD EPYC 9575F processor based on the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates 2 shared vCPUs operating at a nominal clock frequency of 2.0 GHz. The processor includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache, alongside support for instruction extensions such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, and hardware cryptography primitives like AES-NI and SHA-NI. The server is configured with 2.0 GB of system memory, providing 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, and includes 50 GB of local SSD storage along with a single complimentary public IPv4 address. No discrete GPU acceleration is included.

Performance benchmarks show distinct single-thread advantages alongside limits imposed by core count and memory constraints. In single-core evaluations, the instance reaches top-tier standing, recording a stress-ng single-core score of 3787.27, a gzip single-threaded compression throughput of 40.69 GB/sec, and a bzip3 decompression rate of 17.42 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded results align with its 2-core footprint, achieving an average stress-ng multi-core score of 7763.62 and placing in the lower quartile for PassMark CPU (6709.35) and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (33.72 GB/sec). Memory throughput reaches 63.77 GB/sec for uncached large reads and 45.7 GB/sec for uncached writes, although PassMark memory testing registers in the lower decile at 950.54.

The instance demonstrates steady utility metrics across synthetic application tests, producing 10.31 GB/sec in static web serving throughput and 6.18 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads. Small-model inference on a 135M parameter language model delivers 712.08 tokens per second for prompt processing and 186.2 tokens per second for generation. Given the low memory-to-vCPU ratio and shared CPU model, this server is technically matched for single-threaded processing tasks, lightweight static web hosting, small Redis caching instances, background worker queues, and utility automation scripts that fit comfortably within a 2.0 GB memory envelope.
description: UpCloud PREMIUM-2xCPU-2GB is a compact, compute-oriented instance powered by AMD EPYC 9575F processors on KVM virtualization using the x86_64 architecture. It provides 2 shared vCPUs clocked at 2.0 GHz, 2.0 GB of RAM (1.0 GB per vCPU), and 50 GB of bundled local SSD storage, accompanied by one complimentary IPv4 address. Benchmarks highlight exceptional single-thread execution, placing in the top ten percent for stress-ng single-core compute and gzip compression. Multi-core and overall memory subsystem benchmarks reflect entry-tier constraints typical of a two-core configuration with limited RAM capacity. In application testing, the instance maintains 10.31 GB/sec of static web throughput and handles over 6 million Redis operations per second. Lacking a GPU, it functions as an efficient choice for lightweight services, isolated edge proxy nodes, asynchronous background worker jobs, and lightweight web serving where single-core speed takes precedence over large memory footprints.
